questions.stem: 以“Identify temporary term / Temporary is limited period. / Two kinds of contract term”为依据核对材料，哪项结论成立？.

answer.exemplar: A temporary term means employment lasts for a limited period and ends automatically unless renewed.

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: temporary terms last a limited period and end unless renewed. On that basis "A temporary term means employment lasts for a limited period and ends automatically unless…" is the supported choice.

questions.subject: CHINESE

stimulus.body: 材料背景：The brief's contract includes payment for hours worked in a previous period. 请阅读以下材料：四个选项中，只有一个能够从材料本身推出。

questions.stem: 运用“Identify back pay / Back pay covers past hours. / Words for pay”来判断，四个选项中哪一项符合原文？.
questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: close reading of the note yields this rule: back pay covers previous hours. On that basis "Back pay for previous hours" is the supported choice. Option A ("Advance pay for future hours") fails because it confuses previous with future; Option C ("Fine as a penalty") fails because it confuses pay with penalty; Option D ("Deposit as held money") fails because it confuses pay with held funds.

questions.subject: CHINESE

stimulus.body: 请阅读以下材料：四个选项中，只有一个能够从材料本身推出。

questions.stem: 按照“Confirm written terms / Get terms in writing. / Reading a pay offer”检验这段材料，哪一项能够被推出？.

options.text: It removes the need for review
options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "It removes the need for review" for the governing rule

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: what settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: written confirmation prevents misunderstandings. On that basis "It prevents misunderstandings later" is the supported choice. Option A ("It shortens the offer") fails because it values brevity over clarity; Option B ("It guarantees a raise") fails because it overstates confirmation's effect; Option D ("It removes the need for review") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "It removes the need for review" for the governing rule.
